title: Ya and Todavía with the Pretérito Perfecto

sections.content: Use ya to say that an action has already happened and todavía no to say that it has not happened yet. Both combine naturally with the pretérito perfecto: Ya he contestado. Todavía no he enviado el mensaje.

items.english: I have already answered the message.

items.spanish: Todavía no he enviado el mensaje.
items.english: I have not sent the message yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no ha contestado mi padre.
items.english: My father has not answered yet.

sections.content: Use ya for completed recent actions, todavía no for actions that remain unfinished, and porque to explain the reason.
